what: Re-export the macros from blaze-query, as the contract says (blaze_query::{tracked, input, interned, Supertype, Value}): in crates/blaze-query/Cargo.toml [dependencies] add `blaze-query-macros = { path = "../blaze-query-macros" }` (or `.workspace = true` once 01106 lands; cargo allows the cycle, blaze-query-macros only dev-depends on blaze-query), and in crates/blaze-query/src/lib.rs add `pub use blaze_query_macros::{Supertype, Value, input, interned, tracked};`. Why: the port writes `#[blaze_query::tracked]` etc. and nothing re-exports them yet; the macros crate and its integration tests (crates/blaze-query-macros/tests/, written against `blaze_query_macros::` meanwhile) are ready. Note `Value` the derive and `blaze_query::db::Value` the trait live in different namespaces (macro vs type), so the re-export does not clash.

history.note: query-unify -> query-unify-engine: query-unify-engine owns crates/blaze-query/Cargo.toml and the re-export lines of lib.rs; use blaze-query-macros.workspace = true (root has it now).
